register.labelZh: WIPE 片語動詞的實際用途
register.summaryZh: wipe down 表示清潔整個表面;wipe off 則表示擦掉某一處污漬或物質。；你可以用 wipe something up 表示抹走濺出的飲品,也可以在英式英語中用 wipe up 表示把洗好的餐具抹乾。；wipe out 可以表示某人從滑浪板或滑板上跌倒,也可以表示一支球隊以大比數擊敗對手。；wipe something out 表示某事物被完全或幾乎完全消滅。
register.summaryEn: Wipe down describes cleaning a whole surface, while wipe off describes removing a particular mark or substance. You can wipe up spilled drinks and use wipe up in British English when drying washed dishes. Wipe out may describe someone falling from a surfboard or skateboard, or a team winning by a very large score. Wipe something out shows that nothing, or almost nothing, remains.
